# Biomass Engineers Limited

> HETAS-registered specialist biomass boiler engineers based in Exmouth, Devon. We design, install, service and repair biomass boilers across the South West of England — the Bristol – Bournemouth – Penzance triangle. We work on every major manufacturer (Fröling, Hargassner, Herz, Heizomat, Binder, Windhager) and are independent of any single brand.

Founded: pre-2015 (15+ years biomass experience). Directors: Jim King (Lead Engineer), Gary Thorne (Senior Service Engineer). 500+ systems serviced. All work is RHI / OFGEM compliant. In-house coded welding for pressurised pipework.

Coverage: South West England — Devon, Cornwall, Somerset, Dorset, Wiltshire, Bristol, western Hampshire. Approximate service triangle: Bristol (north) → Bournemouth (east) → Penzance (west).

Contact: 07855 586555 · admin@biomass-engineers.co.uk · Mirramar, Bassetts Gardens, Exmouth, Devon, EX8 4EE.

HETAS profile: https://www.hetas.co.uk/business/biomass-engineers-ltd/

## Core services

- [Biomass Boiler Installation](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boiler-installation): Survey-led design, full MCS paperwork, first annual service included. Pellet, chip and log. Domestic, agricultural and commercial.
- [Biomass Boiler Servicing & Maintenance](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boiler-servicing-and-maintenance): Annual servicing on every major brand. RHI-compliant service records issued as standard. No lock-in contracts.
- [Biomass Boiler Servicing & Repair](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boiler-servicing-and-repair): Fault diagnosis, emergency call-outs and standalone engineer visits. Parts sourced for all major brands including orphaned systems.
- [Commercial Biomass Boiler Service](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/commercial-biomass-boiler-service): 50 kW – 3,500 kW. PPM contracts, district-heating specification and commissioning for schools, hotels, leisure and agricultural sites.
- [RHI Compliance](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/renewable-heat-incentive-rhi): Annual compliant servicing, metering checks and OFGEM documentation to protect existing Renewable Heat Incentive payments.
- [Existing Biomass Boilers](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/existing-biomass-boilers): We take on any biomass system regardless of original installer, age, or trading status of original supplier.
- [Parts & Spares](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boiler-parts-and-spares): Sourcing for all major manufacturers and orphaned/discontinued units.
- [Specification & System Design](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boiler-specification-system-design): Bespoke plant-room and fuel-store design from heat demand assessment.
- [District Heating Biomass](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/district-heating-biomass): Multi-building heat networks from a single biomass plant.
- [Coded Welding](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/services/coded-welding): In-house WPS/WPQ welding qualifications for pressurised pipework.

## Brands serviced

- [Fröling](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boilers/froling-biomass-boilers) — Austrian, 15 kW – 1,500 kW. Log, chip, pellet (T4e, PE1, TX300, Lambdamat).
- [Hargassner](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boilers/hargassner-biomass-boilers) — Austrian, 6 kW – 2,500 kW. Chip and pellet (NANO-PK, ECO-PK, MEGA-PK).
- [Herz](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boilers/herz-biomass-boilers) — Austrian, 4 kW – 20,000 kW. Chip, pellet and log (BioFire, firematic, pelletstar).
- [Heizomat](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boilers/heizomat-biomass-boilers) — German, 50 kW – 990 kW. Large wood chip (RHK-AK).
- [Binder](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boilers/binder-biomass-boilers) — German, 150 kW – 10,000 kW. Industrial wood chip travelling-grate.
- [Windhager](https://biomass-engineers.co.uk/biomass-boilers/windhager-biomass-boilers) — Austrian, 2.6 kW – 60 kW. Premium pellet (BioWIN, PuroWIN).
